plugins.name: ace
plugins.description: Code Engine ACE - Intelligent pattern learning with continuous auto-search. v6.6.2: Crash fix — subagent learning no longer dies on the per-agent transcript (8-vs-5 tuple). On SubagentStop, parse_agent_transcript() returned 5-tuples while build_trajectory_from_accumulated_tools unpacks 8 → ValueError crashed the whole subagent learning trace before ace-cli learn (pre-existing since v6.4.0). Fix: parse_agent_transcript() returns 8-tuples matching get_session_tools() (timing fields padded None). Completes the per-agent subagent learning from v6.6.0 — subagents now run their full search→learn cycle (live-verified). Requires: Claude Code >= 2.1.139, ace-cli >= 3.17.0 (@ace-sdk/core >= 2.19.0).
